artist: Oxide & Neutrino feat. So Solid members
title: Rap Dis
label: East West
format: CD single (catalogue number as listed by OCC)

type.basis: Trench (2021) describes garage darkening and laying the foundations for grime; artist pages file it as UK garage.

sound.text: Trench (2021) describes dramatic strings, a shuddering rhythm and rapid-fire MCing from So Solid members.

context.text: Official Singles Chart peak no. 12 (first chart date 8 Dec 2001, 8 weeks).
Trench (2021) places it at the point where garage 'had been getting darker and laying the foundations for grime since the turn of the millennium'.
'Only Wanna Know U Cos Ure Famous' had already appeared on the Dance Singles chart on 9 Jun 2001 (peak 32).

calls.label: darkening garage laying foundations for grime

rels.other: So Solid Crew (Kaish, Harvey, Scat D, Swiss)

uncertainty: Producer not found. Album placement conflicts (Wikipedia: 2 Stepz Ahead). Only one source describes the sound (Trench, no named author). The earlier Dance-chart entry for 'Only Wanna Know U...' (June 2001) suggests an earlier issue of that track that was not verified.
tracklist: Double-titled single. Wikipedia lists it with the album 2 Stepz Ahead (charted Oct 2002); Trench says it is not on Execute.

audit.note: Single not listed on the Oxide & Neutrino artist page (id 14751823). 'Only Wanna Know U Cos Ure Famous' is presumably on the Execute album ('Pop · 2000') but Apple's track list was not visible.
